task.title: Lovable build-time strict env publish audit script
task.summary_zh: SA § 2.2 列為 non-blocking follow-up：execute-plans@main build-time 應使用 strict env (VITE_BFF_MODE=live VITE_BFF_FALLBACK=strict VITE_BFF_REAL_WRITES=false) 重新發佈一次，並驗證發佈後的 bundle 不再含 seed fallback assets。本任務不直接動 execute-plans repo，而是寫一個 pantheon 端的 audit script + evidence packet，記錄 publish 條件、build env、bundle hash、verification probe 結果。
acceptance: audit_lovable_strict_publish.py exposes verify_strict_publish(deployment_url) returning AuditResult dict with strict_env_confirmed bool and missing_flags list
required_build_env.json lists exact VITE_* keys with required values (VITE_BFF_MODE=live VITE_BFF_FALLBACK=strict VITE_BFF_REAL_WRITES=false)
probe fails if deployed bundle requests any path matching /mocks/ or seed.* at runtime
audit_report.md is the human-readable evidence packet template
test_audit_lovable_strict_publish.py covers 1 pass case (all flags strict) and 1 fail case (any flag relaxed) with pytest -q exit 0
no execute-plans repo modification this task only produces audit infrastructure inside pantheon
task.next: Owner finalized strict publish audit infrastructure: evidence packet refreshed, focused checks passed, and no execute-plans repository changes were made.
